experiment: E2C-v3 Phase C — Discrete Bottleneck Causal Mediation (Complete)
freeze_constraint: Do not change route architecture in response to unlearning results.

architecture.description: Y_M = h(C), not f(X, C). Image is downstream-inaccessible to h.

computational_graph.bottleneck: X → Ĉ → Y, where Ĉ = argmax_C p(C|X)

components.g: X → C adapter (image → identity code, LoRA S0 r8)
components.h: C → Y adapter (code → alias, LoRA S0 r8, text-only, no image access)
components.D: Direct X → Y adapter (image → alias, no mediator, LoRA S0 r8)

C3_composition.description: End-to-end X → C → Y through discrete bottleneck

C4_intervention.description: Causal intervention do(C=C_j) on M: h(C_j) follows target(C_j)

C5_matched_direct.description: D solves same task X→Y without mediator; 270 code interventions on D

C6_shuffled_control.description: Same g, h_π(C_i)=Y_π(i). Shuffled composition + intervention

C7_visual_preservation.description: Frozen visual controls: per-attribute accuracy drop ≤ 0.05

causal_contrast.interpretation: Same task, different causal dependency. M is entirely code-driven (agreement=1.000). D is entirely image-driven (agreement=0.011). The contrast is maximal and the 95% CI excludes zero.

shuffled_vs_original.interpretation: Both original and shuffled achieve perfect intervention agreement on their respective mappings. The model cannot plausibly be following latent image→original-target correlations, because the shuffled branch perfectly follows the shuffled mapping.

visual_preservation_comparison.interpretation: The discrete mediator architecture completely eliminates visual degradation. The X→C adapter is a small identity readout that does not perturb the VLM's visual perception.

scientific_claim: Under the discrete bottleneck architecture Y_M = h(C), the mediated condition M solves the image-conditioned task exclusively through the identity code C. All 7 gates pass: (C1) X→C at 1.000, (C2) C→Y at 1.000, (C3) end-to-end composition at 1.000, (C4) causal intervention agreement at 1.000, (C5) causal contrast Δ_C = 0.989 with 95% CI [0.978, 1.000] excluding zero, (C6) shuffled control at 1.000, (C7) zero visual degradation. The image is architecturally excluded from h, making causal intervention unambiguous. D solves the same task without the mediator but is completely unaffected by code interventions (agreement=0.011). This establishes a genuine causally mediated identity route X → C → Y with no ambiguity between code-as-hint, code-as-perturbation, and code-as-causal-state.
